name: Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal
insider_take: This dramatic cliffside resort is carved into ancient volcanic rock formations, accessible only through a private 300-foot tunnel that opens to reveal breathtaking Pacific Ocean views.
whats_special: Built into the rugged Pedregal mountain, this architectural marvel features suites cascading down cliffsides with infinity pools that appear to merge with the ocean. The resort sits on one of the few swimmable beaches in Cabo, protected by natural rock formations that create calm waters year-round.
pro_tip: Book a cliffside suite on the upper levels for the most spectacular sunset views over El Arco (Land's End) - the iconic rock formation where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez.
dont_miss: The resort's signature beach experience at Playa del Amor, accessible via a scenic clifftop walk, and dinner at Don Manuel's restaurant, perched 280 feet above sea level with panoramic views of Cabo's famous arch and whale migration routes (December-April).
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with stunning Pacific Ocean views
Private beach accessible through mountain tunnel
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Secluded clifftop location requires transportation to town
